limits: Self-selected public Google Play reviews from a fixed historical window; not the customer population.
No revenue, plan tier or confirmed cancellation data: cancellation language is expressed intent only.
Labels come from a small model; verifier and golden-set agreement facts show their reliability.
The first and last calendar months of the window are partial.
The baseline score is complaint_count x mean_severity (= severity_sum); it measures review volume weighted by described impact, not business value.
question: Where should the next quarter of product effort go: access, usability, playback, or billing/support?

ranking.description: Customers say choosing or replaying specific parts of songs, skipping, shuffling, repeating, lyrics, and better audio quality are limited or require Premium. Some also report frequent prompts to subscribe.
ranking.name: Free-Tier Features Require Premium

ranking.description: Customers express broad dissatisfaction with the app, calling it bad, annoying, or disappointing. Some specifically say it felt worse after an update.
ranking.name: General App Dissatisfaction

ranking.description: Customers report that ads are too frequent or too long, including ads appearing after a few songs or interrupting access to music.
ranking.name: Frequent and lengthy ads

ranking.description: Customers report unwanted shuffle behavior, inability to select or rearrange songs, and problems with rewind, forward, and playback order. One also says Spotify continues to think they are in a car after they get home.
ranking.name: Playback and playlist controls malfunction

ranking.description: Customers report that the new interface can lag while scrolling and take up screen space with moving content. Some say they can no longer find settings or lists, use player controls, or access features they previously had.
ranking.name: Interface Changes and Missing Controls

ranking.description: Customers say music sometimes will not play or stops and pauses during a song. Some also report that playback does not continue to the next song.
ranking.name: Playback Stops or Fails to Start

ranking.description: Customers report crashes during playback, hangs or unresponsiveness, and problems opening or loading the app. One says they frequently have to reinstall it to get it working.
ranking.name: App Crashes, Freezes, or Fails to Load

ranking.description: Customers report being unable to log in or create an account, including trouble receiving an OTP or finding a password-change option. One customer also says the desktop scanner option for mobile login is unavailable.
ranking.name: Login and Account Setup Problems

ranking.description: Customers report offline or no-internet messages despite having internet access, along with problems playing or controlling music through a car or watch and switching between devices.
ranking.name: Playback connection and device switching issues

ranking.description: Customers say songs are missing from playlists or unavailable in search, and some cannot find particular audiobooks or podcasts. One customer also says podcast videos are not visible.
ranking.name: Songs and podcasts are missing or unavailable

ranking.description: Customers say they cannot download music or play downloaded songs while offline. Some also report that downloads are unavailable to them.
ranking.name: Downloaded Music Fails Offline

ranking.description: Customers report receiving recommended or suggested songs they dislike, including songs added to playlists or played during shuffle. Some also say recommendations repeat or include artists they have blocked.
ranking.name: Unwanted Song Recommendations and Suggestions
